senses.gloss: ? -śollaka, obscure, prob. corrupt: ekaliṅgaṃ gatvā liṅgopari dakṣiṇāyāṃ mūrtiṃ pādaṃ sthāpya vāla-śollakena bandhayet, muṣṭiṃ baddhvā tāvaj japed yāvad rāvo niścarati marāmīti, tṛtīye rāve muṣṭiḥ siddhā bhavati Mmk 〔704.14 ff.〕 I do not understand the passage. AMg. has a word sollaga = Skt. śūlya(-ka), meat roasted on a spit, but I do not see how it could be applied here.
